subject.title: feat(subagents): add execution backend placement contract

question: After fixing the validation defect, should v1 expose only the built-in local placement contract or reserve future container, Kubernetes, and resource-profile semantics now?
rationale: The fail-closed defect has a mechanical repair, but the durable scope of this new public config and model-facing API cannot be determined without maintainer intent.

options.title: Local-only v1
options.body: Accept only the built-in `local` process backend, retain profile-name readback if desired, and defer non-local and resource semantics.

options.title: Approve reserved future API
options.body: Retain the broader backend and profile schema as an explicit compatibility commitment after fixing validation.

options.title: Pause for runner design
options.body: Hold the PR until non-local lifecycle, isolation, resource policy, and worker protocol ownership are settled.

recommendation.title: Local-only v1
recommendation.body: Accept only the built-in `local` process backend, retain profile-name readback if desired, and defer non-local and resource semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects this person to the central spawn architecture, policy, and registry decisions.
